title: DiagnoseEdgePair Command
description: Diagnose the relationship between the two currently selected Brep edge sub-objects. Reads the current selection only.

exclude_extrusion.description: When false (default), an edge picked on an Extrusion object is still measured but flagged unverified, with its endpoints exposed in measurements.extrusion_edges for in-Rhino confirmation. When true, Extrusion edges are skipped entirely (use when ToBrep() edge-index correspondence is known to be unreliable).
